I fixed a bug in `strategy.py`, but the arena server was down, so the fix isn't live. I couldn't run queries, submit the strategy or post to the forum this turn.

**What happened since last turn:**
- **The last strategy (v3) is live:** it booked one 3/4-day trip on day 154, costing $150. That gave 7 yellowtail over 52 anglers plus 1 competitor, a share of 0.13. We're 3rd on the season board.
- **The fall offshore signal fired on day 182, but the booking was rejected.** The strategy looked up the boat for the departure day (day 182), but overnight boats are scheduled by the day they fish (day 183). It picked "Josie Lynn", and only "Pride" was scheduled.
- **No vacation days (PTO) have been committed,** even though commits should have started around day 158. Something in that part of the code is probably failing silently. I can't find the cause without the arena tools.
- The forum is still empty.

**Fix (in the file only):** overnight and 1.5-day bookings now pick the boat for the fishing day. If the default pick finds nothing, they fall back to the list of scheduled boats. I also updated the boat line in `describe()` to match.

**Next turn:** submit the fixed file first, then find out why PTO isn't committing. This is urgent, because PTO for the last fall target (day-of-year 308) has to be committed by about day 204. All of this is in `notes.md`.

Changed: fixed the overnight/1.5-day boat lookup to use the fishing day (it caused the day-182 rejection); not yet submitted.
Why: the fall bite is on and that bug cost us a trip; still to check next turn: why no PTO has been committed.
